description: Irregular table read by rows: Place n points at the integer polar angles of the Archimedean spiral r = k, 0 <= k < n, then around the k-th point draw a circle whose radius is the distance from the k-th point to the (k+1)-th point: T(n,k) is the number of k-sided finite regions formed, for n >= 2, k>=2, in the resulting graph.
